s1.syndrome_frame: Acute skin lesions with vesiculobullous and pustular components on the hand
salient_findings: Vesiculobullous lesions on the dorsal aspect of the left hand
Extension of lesions to the palm and ventral aspect of the thumb
Presence of pustules on eroded areas
key_facts: Patient is a man in his 60s
History of hypertension and diabetes mellitus
Occupation as a butcher and occasional hunter
Contact with hares and rabbits
Lesions appeared on the left hand over 3 days
No fever or other systemic symptoms
Fungal culture was negative
Bacterial culture showed Staphylococcus simulans
Polymerase chain reaction analysis for Erysipelothrix rhusiopathiae was negative

raw.syndrome_frame: Acute skin lesions with vesiculobullous and pustular components on the hand
salient_findings: Vesiculobullous lesions on the dorsal aspect of the left hand

Presence of pustules on eroded areas
key_facts: Patient is a man in his 60s
History of hypertension and diabetes mellitus
Occupation as a butcher and occasional hunter
Contact with hares and rabbits
Lesions appeared on the left hand over 3 days
No fever or other systemic symptoms
Fungal culture was negative
Bacterial culture showed Staphylococcus simulans
Polymerase chain reaction analysis for Erysipelothrix rhusiopathiae was negative

differentials: Cutaneous leishmaniasis due to Leishmania major
per_call: Cutaneous leishmaniasis due to Leishmania major

shortlist.label: Erysipeloid
shortlist.why_kept: Occupational exposure to animals and acute skin lesions

shortlist.label: Staphylococcal scalded skin syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Bacterial culture showed Staphylococcus simulans and presence of vesiculobullous lesions

shortlist.label: Orf virus infection
shortlist.why_kept: Contact with hares and rabbits and presence of lesions on the hand

shortlist.label: Mycobacterium marinum infection
shortlist.why_kept: Occupational exposure to water and animals, and presence of skin lesions

shortlist.label: Cutaneous anthrax
shortlist.why_kept: Occupational exposure to animals and presence of skin lesions with erosion and pustules

raw.rationale: The patient's occupation as a butcher and occasional hunter, along with contact with hares and rabbits, increases the risk of zoonotic transmission of Orf virus, which is commonly found in these animals. The appearance of vesiculobullous lesions on the hand, evolving over a few days without systemic symptoms, is consistent with Orf virus infection.

rejected.label: Erysipeloid
rejected.why: Polymerase chain reaction analysis for Erysipelothrix rhusiopathiae was negative, making this diagnosis less likely

rejected.label: Staphylococcal scalded skin syndrome
rejected.why: Typically presents with fever and systemic symptoms, which are absent in this case

rejected.label: Mycobacterium marinum infection
rejected.why: Usually associated with aquatic exposure, which is not mentioned in the patient's history

rejected.label: Cutaneous anthrax
rejected.why: Would likely present with more severe systemic symptoms and a distinct eschar, which is not described in this case
